# Workflow parser and runtime fixtures

These packages are test inputs, not an extension source or an installed capability
catalog. Tests keep fixed versions so contract and storage regressions remain
reproducible.

Maintained reusable software and UI methods live in `himind-extensions/workflows`.
Project-specific WeChat delivery lives in `himind-ext-projects/workflows`; the
retired duplicate `wechat-miniprogram-delivery` is no longer shipped here.
